title: Hawaii Surcharge Refund Computation for Crestline Companion Bookings
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the refund of the Hawaii surcharge of a cancelled booking is the amount of the most recent Hawaii surcharge charge on the certificate, refunded in full.

## How the refund is formed

1. **Surcharge charge** — the charge entry of component Hawaii surcharge with the latest entry date in the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass.
2. **Surcharge retention** — the surcharge charge less the part of the surcharge that comes back, rounded half up to the cent.
3. **Final surcharge retention** — the surcharge retention multiplied by the repeat factor and then by one minus the combined waiver percentage, rounded half up to the cent once at that point. The waiver percentages are first added into one combined waiver percentage that is applied once, never one after the other.
4. **Hawaii surcharge refund** — the most recent Hawaii surcharge charge on the certificate less the final surcharge retention, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Step | Value |
|---|---|
| Most recent Hawaii surcharge charge on the certificate | 100.00 USD |
| Part of the surcharge that comes back | 100.00 USD, in full |
| Surcharge retention | 0.00 USD |
| Hawaii surcharge refund | 100.00 USD |

**Which surcharge charge is read?** The most recent one on the certificate or pass, by entry date.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
